meta.title: Titan's Lament
meta.description: The scarred planet mourns as it tries to escape its fated fall.

units.rawText: On the Jovian Ringworld, at the Jiutian Sector Administration Center.
units.displayText: On the Jovian Ringworld, at the Jiutian Sector Administration Center.

spans.text: On the Jovian Ringworld, at the Jiutian Sector Administration Center.

units.rawText: The main monitor in the Ops Room shows the satellites of the Saturnian system. A third of them are fully purple-colored now.
units.displayText: The main monitor in the Ops Room shows the satellites of the Saturnian system. A third of them are fully purple-colored now.

spans.text: The main monitor in the Ops Room shows the satellites of the Saturnian system. A third of them are fully purple-colored now.

units.rawText: Pan Base is 75% entropized. We've lost it.
units.displayText: Pan Base is 75% entropized. We've lost it.

spans.text: Pan Base is 75% entropized. We've lost it.

units.rawText: Epimetheus Base is currently engaged in combat. Operand reserves are at 40% and combat personnel casualties are at 65%.
units.displayText: Epimetheus Base is currently engaged in combat. Operand reserves are at 40% and combat personnel casualties are at 65%.

spans.text: Epimetheus Base is currently engaged in combat. Operand reserves are at 40% and combat personnel casualties are at 65%.

units.rawText: As the news keeps coming in, Xuannu's expression grows more and more severe.
units.displayText: As the news keeps coming in, Xuannu's expression grows more and more severe.

spans.text: As the news keeps coming in, Xuannu's expression grows more and more severe.

units.rawText: Administrator! Titan has deviated from its regular orbit and is heading toward the comet at high speed. It has exceeded the third cosmic velocity and is still accelerating!
units.displayText: Administrator! Titan has deviated from its regular orbit and is heading toward the comet at high speed. It has exceeded the third cosmic velocity and is still accelerating!

spans.text: Administrator! Titan has deviated from its regular orbit and is heading toward the comet at high speed. It has exceeded the third cosmic velocity and is still accelerating!

units.rawText: Someone has activated the Stellar Engines on Titan. Xinghuan and the others must be planning to use it to strike the comet!
units.displayText: Someone has activated the Stellar Engines on Titan. Xinghuan and the others must be planning to use it to strike the comet!

spans.text: Someone has activated the Stellar Engines on Titan. Xinghuan and the others must be planning to use it to strike the comet!

units.rawText: Detecting distress signal from an escape pod in the nearby region! Exact identity of the survivor in question is not...
units.displayText: Detecting distress signal from an escape pod in the nearby region! Exact identity of the survivor in question is not...

spans.text: Detecting distress signal from an escape pod in the nearby region! Exact identity of the survivor in question is not...

units.rawText: Before he can finish, the monitor shows the comet breaking up into countless fragments as clouds of dust fill the silent void. The comet has finally fallen, but the agents watching this disaster do not take the least bit of joy in it.
units.displayText: Before he can finish, the monitor shows the comet breaking up into countless fragments as clouds of dust fill the silent void. The comet has finally fallen, but the agents watching this disaster do not take the least bit of joy in it.

spans.text: Before he can finish, the monitor shows the comet breaking up into countless fragments as clouds of dust fill the silent void. The comet has finally fallen, but the agents watching this disaster do not take the least bit of joy in it.

units.rawText: Comet signal lost. Titan Base signal lost.
units.displayText: Comet signal lost. Titan Base signal lost.

spans.text: Comet signal lost. Titan Base signal lost.

units.rawText: ...Have the other observation bases use their optical telescopes to continue monitoring the comet's status. Also, calculate the probability of the entropic leader's survival.
units.displayText: ...Have the other observation bases use their optical telescopes to continue monitoring the comet's status. Also, calculate the probability of the entropic leader's survival.

spans.text: ...Have the other observation bases use their optical telescopes to continue monitoring the comet's status. Also, calculate the probability of the entropic leader's survival.

units.rawText: All reserves in all bases are to make Titan-fall and eliminate all remaining entropics.
units.displayText: All reserves in all bases are to make Titan-fall and eliminate all remaining entropics.

spans.text: All reserves in all bases are to make Titan-fall and eliminate all remaining entropics.

units.rawText: Clomp clomp—
units.displayText: Clomp clomp—

spans.text: Clomp clomp—

units.rawText: Xuannu! What happened to Titan?!
units.displayText: Xuannu! What happened to Titan?!

spans.text: Xuannu! What happened to Titan?!

units.rawText: Yuwang rushes into the Admin Center, holding Liuxing in his arms.
units.displayText: Yuwang rushes into the Admin Center, holding Liuxing in his arms.

spans.text: Yuwang rushes into the Admin Center, holding Liuxing in his arms.

units.rawText: Titan fired its Stellar Engines and destroyed the comet. We achieved results beyond our expectations. The entropics will not pose a threat to the Jovian Ringworld.
units.displayText: Titan fired its Stellar Engines and destroyed the comet. We achieved results beyond our expectations. The entropics will not pose a threat to the Jovian Ringworld.

spans.text: Titan fired its Stellar Engines and destroyed the comet. We achieved results beyond our expectations. The entropics will not pose a threat to the Jovian Ringworld.

units.rawText: I received the message you sent on the way back. Victory will ultimately belong to Jiutian and Xinghuan's efforts will not be in vain.
units.displayText: I received the message you sent on the way back. Victory will ultimately belong to Jiutian and Xinghuan's efforts will not be in vain.

spans.text: I received the message you sent on the way back. Victory will ultimately belong to Jiutian and Xinghuan's efforts will not be in vain.

units.rawText: But what about Xinghuan?
units.displayText: But what about Xinghuan?

spans.text: But what about Xinghuan?

units.rawText: Calm down.
units.displayText: Calm down.

spans.text: Calm down.

units.rawText: (Exhales) Xuannu, I can't stay calm. Please tell me, what happened to Xinghuan?
units.displayText: (Exhales) Xuannu, I can't stay calm. Please tell me, what happened to Xinghuan?

spans.text: (Exhales) Xuannu, I can't stay calm. Please tell me, what happened to Xinghuan?

units.rawText: Xuannu turns to face the screen. There is a small, blinking signal contact not far from Titan.
units.displayText: Xuannu turns to face the screen. There is a small, blinking signal contact not far from Titan.

spans.text: Xuannu turns to face the screen. There is a small, blinking signal contact not far from Titan.

units.rawText: We picked up the distress signal from an escape pod in the surrounding space. The pod did not respond to our hails, so we cannot be sure if Xinghuan is inside.
units.displayText: We picked up the distress signal from an escape pod in the surrounding space. The pod did not respond to our hails, so we cannot be sure if Xinghuan is inside.

spans.text: We picked up the distress signal from an escape pod in the surrounding space. The pod did not respond to our hails, so we cannot be sure if Xinghuan is inside.

units.rawText: She's got to be in there. Send me the coordinates.
units.displayText: She's got to be in there. Send me the coordinates.

spans.text: She's got to be in there. Send me the coordinates.

units.rawText: Administrator! High-energy operand fluctuations detected from within the remains of Titan.
units.displayText: Administrator! High-energy operand fluctuations detected from within the remains of Titan.

spans.text: Administrator! High-energy operand fluctuations detected from within the remains of Titan.

units.rawText: Have you analyzed the waveforms yet?
units.displayText: Have you analyzed the waveforms yet?

spans.text: Have you analyzed the waveforms yet?

units.rawText: Fluctuation source verified. Waveform is a perfect match for entropic entities.
units.displayText: Fluctuation source verified. Waveform is a perfect match for entropic entities.

spans.text: Fluctuation source verified. Waveform is a perfect match for entropic entities.

units.rawText: Is that entropic still alive after being hit by Titan?
units.displayText: Is that entropic still alive after being hit by Titan?

spans.text: Is that entropic still alive after being hit by Titan?

units.rawText: The explosion that went off at the moment of collision was too unnatural. Perhaps... Perhaps it was not Titan that destroyed the comet.
units.displayText: The explosion that went off at the moment of collision was too unnatural. Perhaps... Perhaps it was not Titan that destroyed the comet.

spans.text: The explosion that went off at the moment of collision was too unnatural. Perhaps... Perhaps it was not Titan that destroyed the comet.

units.rawText: Administrator, Titan Base is still present. The high-energy operand fluctuations are emanating from it.
units.displayText: Administrator, Titan Base is still present. The high-energy operand fluctuations are emanating from it.

spans.text: Administrator, Titan Base is still present. The high-energy operand fluctuations are emanating from it.

units.rawText: Detecting unnatural activity among the entropic hordes in the Saturnian system. They are currently converging on Titan Base.
units.displayText: Detecting unnatural activity among the entropic hordes in the Saturnian system. They are currently converging on Titan Base.

spans.text: Detecting unnatural activity among the entropic hordes in the Saturnian system. They are currently converging on Titan Base.

units.rawText: Has she taken Titan for herself... <size=40>All combat personnel, make Titan-fall immediately and prepare for a decapitation operation!</size>
units.displayText: Has she taken Titan for herself... All combat personnel, make Titan-fall immediately and prepare for a decapitation operation!

spans.text: Has she taken Titan for herself...
All combat personnel, make Titan-fall immediately and prepare for a decapitation operation!

units.rawText: After her solemn call to battle, Xuannu pauses briefly, then follows up with another order.
units.displayText: After her solemn call to battle, Xuannu pauses briefly, then follows up with another order.

spans.text: After her solemn call to battle, Xuannu pauses briefly, then follows up with another order.

units.rawText: Titan Area D 08th Team, prioritize rescue operations instead... Recover that escape pod ASAP.
units.displayText: Titan Area D 08th Team, prioritize rescue operations instead... Recover that escape pod ASAP.

spans.text: Titan Area D 08th Team, prioritize rescue operations instead... Recover that escape pod ASAP.

units.rawText: <size=40>Yes, ma'am!</size>
units.displayText: Yes, ma'am!

spans.text: Yes, ma'am!

units.rawText: Thank you, Xuannu.
units.displayText: Thank you, Xuannu.

spans.text: Thank you, Xuannu.

units.rawText: This is the final battle and I can't spare any more help. Make good use of the people you've been assigned and bring her back.
units.displayText: This is the final battle and I can't spare any more help. Make good use of the people you've been assigned and bring her back.

spans.text: This is the final battle and I can't spare any more help. Make good use of the people you've been assigned and bring her back.

units.rawText: Just because we're in a battle doesn't make things any different from normal. If there's anything I can do to help, please tell me and I will do my best to meet your expectations.
units.displayText: Just because we're in a battle doesn't make things any different from normal. If there's anything I can do to help, please tell me and I will do my best to meet your expectations.

spans.text: Just because we're in a battle doesn't make things any different from normal. If there's anything I can do to help, please tell me and I will do my best to meet your expectations.

units.rawText: After taking your keen sense of the big picture and your calm judgement into consideration, it would be for the best if you could take over as operational commander for the forces in Area D.
units.displayText: After taking your keen sense of the big picture and your calm judgement into consideration, it would be for the best if you could take over as operational commander for the forces in Area D.

spans.text: After taking your keen sense of the big picture and your calm judgement into consideration, it would be for the best if you could take over as operational commander for the forces in Area D.

units.rawText: Area D is a crucial flank battlefield and the 08th Team has been assigned to search for Xinghuan.
units.displayText: Area D is a crucial flank battlefield and the 08th Team has been assigned to search for Xinghuan.

spans.text: Area D is a crucial flank battlefield and the 08th Team has been assigned to search for Xinghuan.

units.rawText: Xuannu turns and hands Yuwang an operational command terminal.
units.displayText: Xuannu turns and hands Yuwang an operational command terminal.

spans.text: Xuannu turns and hands Yuwang an operational command terminal.

units.rawText: Apart from the usual command suite, this terminal also has the precise location of the escape pod on it.
units.displayText: Apart from the usual command suite, this terminal also has the precise location of the escape pod on it.

spans.text: Apart from the usual command suite, this terminal also has the precise location of the escape pod on it.

units.rawText: Xuannu... Are you...
units.displayText: Xuannu... Are you...

spans.text: Xuannu... Are you...

units.rawText: Gagarin, prepare my exo-armor.
units.displayText: Gagarin, prepare my exo-armor.

spans.text: Gagarin, prepare my exo-armor.

units.rawText: Understood.
units.displayText: Understood.

spans.text: Understood.

units.rawText: Good luck, Yuwang.
units.displayText: Good luck, Yuwang.

spans.text: Good luck, Yuwang.

units.rawText: Xuannu lightly pats Yuwang's shoulder before turning and leaving the Admin Center.
units.displayText: Xuannu lightly pats Yuwang's shoulder before turning and leaving the Admin Center.

spans.text: Xuannu lightly pats Yuwang's shoulder before turning and leaving the Admin Center.

units.rawText: ...And good luck to you, Xuannu.
units.displayText: ...And good luck to you, Xuannu.

spans.text: ...And good luck to you, Xuannu.

units.rawText: Return in triumph, glory to Jiutian.
units.displayText: Return in triumph, glory to Jiutian.

spans.text: Return in triumph, glory to Jiutian.

units.rawText: Jiutian sector, Titan.
units.displayText: Jiutian sector, Titan.

spans.text: Jiutian sector, Titan.

units.rawText: Entropized meteors pound the moon's surface relentlessly, and what was once the observation base is now nothing but rubble.
units.displayText: Entropized meteors pound the moon's surface relentlessly, and what was once the observation base is now nothing but rubble.

spans.text: Entropized meteors pound the moon's surface relentlessly, and what was once the observation base is now nothing but rubble.

units.rawText: In this dead zone, the thick smoke gradually thins out, and a humanoid form emerges from it. entropics steadily crawl out of the pits around it and gather around without a word being said.
units.displayText: In this dead zone, the thick smoke gradually thins out, and a humanoid form emerges from it. entropics steadily crawl out of the pits around it and gather around without a word being said.

spans.text: In this dead zone, the thick smoke gradually thins out, and a humanoid form emerges from it. entropics steadily crawl out of the pits around it and gather around without a word being said.

units.rawText: A Low-Order Entropic carefully advances to investigate the situation, but a hand suddenly reaches out, grabs it and crushes it into a spray of ichor.
units.displayText: A Low-Order Entropic carefully advances to investigate the situation, but a hand suddenly reaches out, grabs it and crushes it into a spray of ichor.

spans.text: A Low-Order Entropic carefully advances to investigate the situation, but a hand suddenly reaches out, grabs it and crushes it into a spray of ichor.

units.rawText: <size=40>What a disgrace...</size>
units.displayText: What a disgrace...

spans.text: What a disgrace...

units.rawText: The witch amidst the ruins speaks in a hoarse voice, hatred burning brightly in her eyes.
units.displayText: The witch amidst the ruins speaks in a hoarse voice, hatred burning brightly in her eyes.

spans.text: The witch amidst the ruins speaks in a hoarse voice, hatred burning brightly in her eyes.

units.rawText: I can't believe a mere rat managed to trick me!
units.displayText: I can't believe a mere rat managed to trick me!

spans.text: I can't believe a mere rat managed to trick me!

units.rawText: Caina's rage is unstoppable, and it just so happens an entropized meteor is falling directly on her. Caina holds her hand out toward the meteor, which suddenly begins to tremble in a strange way.
units.displayText: Caina's rage is unstoppable, and it just so happens an entropized meteor is falling directly on her. Caina holds her hand out toward the meteor, which suddenly begins to tremble in a strange way.

spans.text: Caina's rage is unstoppable, and it just so happens an entropized meteor is falling directly on her. Caina holds her hand out toward the meteor, which suddenly begins to tremble in a strange way.

units.rawText: <size=40>Kaboom!!</size>
units.displayText: Kaboom!!

spans.text: Kaboom!!

units.rawText: The meteor explodes violently, sending debris everywhere.
units.displayText: The meteor explodes violently, sending debris everywhere.

spans.text: The meteor explodes violently, sending debris everywhere.

units.rawText: Dammit, if I hadn't ordered the comet to explode just now, that rat might actually have gotten her wish...
units.displayText: Dammit, if I hadn't ordered the comet to explode just now, that rat might actually have gotten her wish...

spans.text: Dammit, if I hadn't ordered the comet to explode just now, that rat might actually have gotten her wish...

units.rawText: How am I going to capture their HQ now that the comet's gone... Dammit!
units.displayText: How am I going to capture their HQ now that the comet's gone... Dammit!

spans.text: How am I going to capture their HQ now that the comet's gone... Dammit!

units.rawText: Hssss—
units.displayText: Hssss—

spans.text: Hssss—

units.rawText: Hm? Lots of agents are heading over from Jupiter... Perfect, I'm still mad and need to take it out on someone!
units.displayText: Hm? Lots of agents are heading over from Jupiter... Perfect, I'm still mad and need to take it out on someone!

spans.text: Hm? Lots of agents are heading over from Jupiter... Perfect, I'm still mad and need to take it out on someone!

units.rawText: If I steal one of their spaceships, will we get the chance to visit Jupiter? Hahahahahahaha—
units.displayText: If I steal one of their spaceships, will we get the chance to visit Jupiter? Hahahahahahaha—

spans.text: If I steal one of their spaceships, will we get the chance to visit Jupiter? Hahahahahahaha—

units.rawText: Caina excitedly stabs her great sword into the ground. It glows with a sinister light, and the purple veins burrow and extend beneath the ground.
units.displayText: Caina excitedly stabs her great sword into the ground. It glows with a sinister light, and the purple veins burrow and extend beneath the ground.

spans.text: Caina excitedly stabs her great sword into the ground. It glows with a sinister light, and the purple veins burrow and extend beneath the ground.

units.rawText: In just a few minutes, the ground and everything as far as the eye can see is now a dull purple color as the planet laments in silence.
units.displayText: In just a few minutes, the ground and everything as far as the eye can see is now a dull purple color as the planet laments in silence.

spans.text: In just a few minutes, the ground and everything as far as the eye can see is now a dull purple color as the planet laments in silence.

units.rawText: Let's get ready to rumble, boys!
units.displayText: Let's get ready to rumble, boys!

spans.text: Let's get ready to rumble, boys!

units.rawText: It's time for some payback.
units.displayText: It's time for some payback.

spans.text: It's time for some payback.

units.rawText: <size=60>HSSSSS!!!!!</size>
units.displayText: HSSSSS!!!!!

spans.text: HSSSSS!!!!!
